name: BID WHIST
description: Bid Whist is a classic American partnership trick-taking game that evolved from standard Whist. It features a competitive bidding auction where partnerships bid for the right to choose the trump suit and determine whether the ranking will be 'Uptown' (High cards win), 'Downtown' (Low cards win), or 'No Trump'. It is particularly celebrated in African-American culture, where it is played with immense skill, sophisticated signaling, and high social energy.

content.text: Bid Whist is a classic American partnership trick-taking game that evolved from standard Whist. It features a competitive bidding auction where partnerships bid for the right to choose the trump suit and determine whether the ranking will be 'Uptown' (High cards win), 'Downtown' (Low cards win), or 'No Trump'. It is particularly celebrated in African-American culture, where it is played with immense skill, sophisticated signaling, and high social energy.

Originating in the United States in the late 19th or early 20th century, Bid Whist grew out of the standard Whist brought by European settlers but was heavily adapted by African-American communities into a complex tactical game.
54 cards: Standard 52-card pack plus two distinct Jokers (Big Joker and Little Joker).
Standard pack with jokers, score pad.
Deal 12 cards to each player. 6 cards are dealt face down to the center to form the 'Kitty'.
